claim: Sevoflurane inhalation induction에서 연구된 소아 DS군은 TD군보다 서맥을 더 자주 경험했다.
limitations: Single context; no randomization; endpoint definition and generalizability require protocol audit
research_implication: Pediatric sevoflurane induction is a justified characterization target, not a universal DS risk claim.

claim: 같은 전향 연구에서 서맥과 저혈압은 sympathetic failure 관찰과 연관되었다.
quantitative_result: DS hypotension 23/80 (29%); association reported
limitations: Association does not establish a single causal mechanism
research_implication: Sympathetic activity is a mechanistic research variable, not a treatment target in this product.

claim: PMID 40376277 초록의 hypotension 하위집단 분모는 내부 불일치가 있어 그대로 재인용할 수 없다.
quantitative_result: Abstract reports 23/80 hypotension, then 15/28 with sympathetic failure
limitations: Denominator 28 is not reconciled in the abstract; full-text/table verification required
research_implication: Do not use 15/28 as a product statistic until clinician/full-text reconciliation.

claim: 후향 matched 연구에서도 소아 DS군은 sevoflurane 유도 중 서맥 및 HR 감소가 더 컸다.
sample: 96 DS cases identified among 11201 pediatric anesthetics; matched comparison
comparator: Matched by age, CHD, ASA status
quantitative_result: Higher bradycardia prevalence and larger HR decrease; exact rate not in PubMed abstract
limitations: Retrospective; single pediatric center; treatment counts did not differ
research_implication: Supports replication of HR trajectory, not efficacy or treatment guidance.

claim: 별도 후향 연구도 sevoflurane 유도 첫 360초 동안 DS군의 서맥 증가를 보고했다.
quantitative_result: Multivariable analysis retained DS and lower ASA status as independent factors
limitations: Retrospective; one drug/context; operational bradycardia definition must be reproduced
research_implication: Use as endpoint-definition source for pediatric sevoflurane characterization.

claim: 두 소아 sevoflurane 연구에서 CHD 유무와 별개인 DS 관련성이 관찰되었다.
sample: 96 DS in one study; 209 DS and 268 controls in another
quantitative_result: Similar DS finding with and without CHD; DS retained in multivariable model
limitations: Residual confounding and center-specific practice remain
research_implication: CHD stratification is mandatory; independence is not proof that CHD is clinically irrelevant.

claim: DS procedural sedation cohort는 비교군보다 혈압 감소 폭이 컸다.
quantitative_result: SBP mean difference -12.3 mmHg (95% CI -16.1 to -8.6); DBP -10.2 mmHg (95% CI -13.3 to -7.0)
limitations: Retrospective; sedation protocols heterogeneous; authors state clinical significance remains uncertain
research_implication: Supports BP trajectory characterization; does not set a clinical alarm threshold.

claim: 한 단일기관 DS 소아 코호트에서 비심장 수술·영상 마취의 기록상 합병증률은 낮았다.
quantitative_result: 51 complications; 2.98%; respiratory events 43.1% of complications
limitations: No internal control; definitions/ascertainment and repeated anesthetics; tertiary-center selection
research_implication: Do not claim all perioperative complications are generally elevated in DS.

claim: Resting HRV meta-analysis found limited evidence of lower RMSSD in DS, while other resting metrics were not consistently different.
quantitative_result: RMSSD Hedges g -0.55 (95% CI -0.93 to -0.16); only resting comparison reported significant in summary
limitations: Small heterogeneous studies; non-anesthesia; study protocols differ
research_implication: Resting HRV alone is insufficient for individual anesthesia risk classification.

claim: 작은 비마취 실험에서 DS군은 정적 운동 중 낮은 baroreflex sensitivity와 둔화된 HR/BP 반응을 보였다.
quantitative_result: Lower BRS after controlling resting SBP; attenuated HR/BP responses
limitations: Very small; exercise not anesthesia; older study
research_implication: Baroreflex impairment is a plausible research mechanism, not a patient-level diagnosis.

claim: upright tilt 실험은 DS군의 자율신경 조절 반응 차이를 관찰했다.
quantitative_result: Reduced normalized HF/LF/LF-HF responses and smaller BRS change reported
limitations: Small; non-anesthesia; posture and respiration confounding
research_implication: Supports dynamic rather than resting-only hypothesis.

claim: 전통적 short-term HRV 표준은 안정된 약 5분 구간을 중심으로 정의되었다.
quantitative_result: No patient event rate
limitations: 1996 standard; anesthesia nonstationarity not specifically validated
research_implication: Five-minute metrics are reference features; shorter windows need metric-specific validation.

claim: LF/HF는 단순한 sympathovagal balance 지표로 정확히 해석할 수 없다.
quantitative_result: No single numeric effect
limitations: LF has mixed determinants; HF depends strongly on respiration; ratio inherits both problems
research_implication: UI must not label LF/HF as a direct sympathetic/parasympathetic balance.

claim: 건강인 ultra-short 연구에서는 RMSSD가 일부 짧은 구간에서 재현 가능했지만 SDNN과 spectral 지표는 같은 방식으로 일반화되지 않았다.
quantitative_result: RMSSD reliable in tested ultra-short setting; SDNN not equivalently reliable
limitations: Healthy/resting setting; anesthesia artifacts and nonstationarity absent
research_implication: Only validated metric/window combinations may enter feature registry.

claim: 주파수영역 HRV는 짧은 구간에서 정확도가 특히 떨어질 수 있다.
quantitative_result: Low-frequency metrics were poorly accurate below approximately 10 minutes in tested data
limitations: Not anesthesia-specific; technology and preprocessing differ
research_implication: LF/HF must be suppressed when duration/stationarity requirements fail.

claim: paced breathing은 ultra-short HRV 값과 신뢰도에 영향을 준다.
quantitative_result: RMSSD/SD1 comparatively more reliable; controlled breathing changed measurements
limitations: Healthy/resting; small sample
research_implication: Ventilation state and respiratory rate must be covariates/quality context.

claim: 2026 resting 연구는 coarse frequency-domain 추정에도 지표별 최소 길이가 다름을 보였다.
quantitative_result: Approximate coarse estimates reported near 60 s for HF and 100 s for LF; narrower agreement required about 200 s HF and 290 s LF
limitations: New study; resting healthy setting; not anesthesia or DS
research_implication: Treat as sensitivity-analysis input only; do not turn these durations into clinical cutoffs.

claim: 현재 근거는 모든 마취제·모든 연령·모든 마취 단계에서 동일한 DS 위험을 입증하지 않는다.
population_age: Mostly children; one children/young adult sedation cohort
exposure_context: Main positive studies center on sevoflurane induction or procedural sedation
quantitative_result: No universal effect estimate exists
limitations: Sparse drug- and age-specific comparative data
research_implication: Product language must name the studied context and avoid universalization.

claim: Atropine hypersensitivity in DS is not sufficiently supported for a product claim or protocol rule.
source_identifier: No qualifying modern comparative source identified in reviewed seed set as of 2026-09-02
quantitative_result: No verified quantitative estimate
limitations: Absence in reviewed evidence is not proof of absence; clinical pharmacology review remains required
research_implication: Do not display or encode atropine-specific sensitivity claims.

claim: 구체적 마취제 감량 비율이나 특정 약물 우선 사용은 이 연구 문서의 근거로 지지되지 않는다.
source_identifier: No qualifying source identifier for a universal percentage or preferred-drug rule
quantitative_result: No verified quantitative estimate
limitations: Regimen- and patient-specific confounding; treatment research outside Path B
research_implication: No dose or drug recommendation feature is permitted.

claim: 제품 필요성은 DS 환자에서 특정 맥락의 생리 변화가 관찰되었고 개인별 신호 궤적을 검증할 데이터가 부족하다는 연구 격차로만 설명한다.
population_age: Target DS cohort not yet collected
quantitative_result: No claimed efficacy
limitations: Public datasets do not establish DS-specific calibration or clinical utility
research_implication: Use neutral RUO wording and prospective silent validation.
